title: Quinoa-Stuffed Zucchini
subtitle: with lemon, yoghurt and herb sauce
description: Zucchini filled with a herby quinoa, avocado and pine nut stuffing, baked until charred at the edges and served with yoghurt.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Bake the whole zucchini for about 15 minutes until slightly softened and easy to hollow out. Let cool.
Leave the oven on and raise the temperature to 220°C.

Put the quinoa, 2 cups water and the salt in a pot and bring to the boil. Lower the heat, cover and cook for about 10 minutes, only until the water is absorbed. Do not cook it all the way, keep it slightly firm. Let cool.
Mix the cooked quinoa with half of the yoghurt, the lemon juice, chopped herbs, chopped chilli, crushed garlic, pine nuts, olive oil and mashed avocado.
For round zucchini, cut off the tops and scoop out the flesh with a teaspoon. For long zucchini, halve lengthways and scoop out the flesh. If very wet, pat dry with paper towel.
Fill the zucchini generously, making a small mound of filling on top.
Place in the tray and bake for about 15 minutes until charred at the edges and the filling is golden. Serve with the remaining yoghurt.
